mapper.select: SELECT NOTICE_NO noticeNo , NOTICE_TITLE noticeTitle , ENROLL_DATE createDate , VIEW_COUNT viewCount FROM CL_NOTICE WHERE STATUS='Y' ORDER BY NOTICE_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_NOTICE WHERE STATUS='Y'
SELECT NOTICE_TITLE noticeTitle , NOTICE_CONTENT noticeContent , VIEW_COUNT viewCount , ENROLL_DATE createDate FROM CL_NOTICE WHERE STATUS='Y' AND NOTICE_NO = #{noticeNo}
SELECT FILE_NO fileNo , ORIGIN_NAME originName , CHANGE_NAME changeName , FILE_PATH filePath , UPLOAD_DATE uploadDate FROM CL_NOTICE_ATTACHMENT WHERE REF_BNO = #{noticeNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE CL_NOTICE SET VIEW_COUNT = VIEW_COUNT+1 WHERE NOTICE_NO = #{noticeNo}
